description.en: Compaction-driven project memory for DeepSeek Harness: searchable cited dictionary, adaptive injection, multi-agent sharing.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的压缩驱动项目记忆：可检索引文词典、自适应注入与多 agent 共享。

description.en: Deterministically compiles DSH compaction deltas into a project-local dictionary (ten entry kinds, typed relations, seq citations, summary tree), injects a long-range digest beside the native checkpoint, and can take over the compaction provider through an agent preset.
description.zh: 把 DSH 压缩增量确定性编译为项目本地词典（十类词条、类型化关系、seq 引文、摘要树），在原生 checkpoint 旁按需注入长程 digest，并可通过 agent 预设接管压缩 provider。
